subject: Private hosting architecture review — availability poll
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kent <s.kent@medsys.io>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medsys.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private hosting architecture review — availability poll

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the interest in a private deployment for MedSys. To make the architecture deep-dive productive, we'd like to reserve 90 minutes to walk through: VPC networking, on-prem footprint options, air-gapped constraints, and a short ops runbook draft.

Can you share the team's availability over the next two weeks? Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed 9/2: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Fri 9/4: 08:30–10:00 or 15:00–16:30
- Tue 9/8: 11:00–12:30

If none of those work, please propose alternatives.

Prework: we'll attach a short prework checklist and would appreciate MedSys network diagram(s) and any specific compliance constraints (airgap policies, allowed outbound IPs, approved KMS/HSM vendors) ahead of the session if possible.

Attaching RH-Prework-Checklist.pdf for reference.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachment: RH-Prework-Checklist.pdf (1 page, PDF)
From: Sarah Kent <s.kent@medsys.io>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medsys.io>, MedSys IT <it@medsys.io>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 08:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private hosting architecture review — availability poll

Hi Rafael —

Thanks for the checklist and the time options. Quick notes from our side:
- We're aiming for a 90-minute session; the agenda looks good.
- Network diagrams attached (see MedSys_network_diagram_v1.pdf).
- Compliance note: our security team requires no outbound connections from the air-gapped environment except to a specified update gateway; we will send the gateway IPs in a separate email.

Availability: the earliest slot that works for the technical leads is Fri 9/4 15:00–16:30 PT. If you can extend to 90 minutes to include the ops runbook, can we do 15:00–16:30 PT (I know your note says 90 min — that slot is 90).

Also, can Monica and Camila share the expected list of attendees from Redwood (role/title) so we can make sure the right people join?

Thanks,
Sarah Kent
Head of Cloud Ops | MedSys
s.kent@medsys.io

Attachment: MedSys_network_diagram_v1.pdf (2 pages, PDF)

Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private hosting architecture review — availability poll

Hi Sarah —

Fri 9/4 15:00–16:30 PT works for us; I will block 90 minutes on our side.

Expected Redwood attendees (initial list):
- Rafael Mendes — Solutions Engineer (architecture, networking)
- Monica Patel — Product - Private Deployments (deployment patterns, rollouts)
- Camila Reyes — Security & Compliance (airgap controls, KMS integrations)
- Priyom Das — Customer Success (runbook and cutover planning)

Prework request: could you also include a short list of any third-party appliances or HSM vendors you expect to use? That will help Camila prepare the KMS/HSM compatibility checklist.

I'll draft a calendar invite and include a short agenda. Rafael — any constraints on recording or screen sharing for air-gapped topics?

Thanks,
Monica

Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private hosting architecture review — availability poll

Perfect — Fri 9/4 15:00–16:30 PT is confirmed on our side. I've created the event and included a short agenda + prework checklist. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-medarch-0903

Agenda (90m):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) VPC design and peering options (20m)
3) On-prem footprint and hardware sizing (20m)
4) Air-gapped update flows & approved egress patterns (20m)
5) Ops runbook & next steps (15m)

Prework requested (from MedSys): network diagram (received), list of HSM/KMS vendors (please send by EOD Thu 9/3), outbound gateway IPs for update channel (as Sarah noted).

Recording policy: we can record the session for internal notes, but if you prefer not to have audio/video recorded due to airgap constraints, we'll disable recording and instead capture a written readout. Please advise.

Attached: RH-Prework-Checklist.pdf (same) and a short internal readout template we will use post-call.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the session.

Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
